activity_statements.statement: operates approximately 1,700 home improvement retail stores across the US and Canada selling building materials, appliances, tools, lawn and garden, flooring and home decor
serves DIY consumers and professional contractors through in-store, online and Pro services channels for home improvement and construction projects
invests in AI and technology to support store operations, supply chain and associate productivity as evidenced by company AI Day events and technology communications
manages a large supply chain network distributing home improvement merchandise to store locations across North America
partners with Habitat for Humanity and community organizations as part of corporate citizenship commitments, while creating career pathways for hourly associates
